_comment: Sky Vision videos. Two formats: YouTube (set 'id' = the watch?v= part, plays inline) or NFHS Network (set 'url' = full NFHS event URL and 'source':'nfhs', opens in new tab — NFHS blocks iframe embedding). Optional 'thumb': omit for auto-thumbnail, or use a full image URL. Optional 'date': ISO date string. Order here is display order — first entry is the large feature.
